messages:
Zara Khan: Hi everyone 1 Zara here, joining as a Product Designer. I can open most Figma files but get a 403 on the FigJam templates folder and the Notion research page links to Drive recordings that I can't access. Who should I ping for Drive/FigJam perms?
Ben Ortiz: Welcome Zara! :tada: Tagging @Maya who owns the Research archive and Figma invites. FigJam lives in the Design Playbooks file (Product / Playbooks). If you accepted with a non-work account that can cause perms weirdness.
Maya Chen: Hey Zara :wave: Ill check Drive and FigJam. Which email did you accept with? I can add you to the Research Archive and the FigJam folder directly.
Zara Khan: Used zara.khan@redwood.com. I can open Figma files but FigJam link still shows "You don't have permission to view this file".
Robin Alvarez: I maintain the FigJam templates folder 1 adding you now. FYI for prototypes: we use `design-staging.redwood` (internal workspace) for interactive builds; if you need a staging deploy ping #eng-platform to provision an env.
Maya Chen: Done 1 added Zara as Viewer to Research Archive (GDrive) and Editor on the FigJam templates folder so you can duplicate templates. Also left a note in Notion (Product > Playbooks > Research Sprints) about where to paste consent text.
onboard-bot: :sparkles: Welcome Zara Khan! Onboarding checklist created. Action items: complete security training, join #design-system, review Product Roadmap (Notion link).
Zara Khan: Amazing, thanks! One more quick thing 1 where do Product OKRs live? Want to align my first-week goals.
Ben Ortiz: Product OKRs are in Notion under Product > Strategy > OKRs. I'll add you as a viewer and DM a one-week ramp checklist that most new designers follow.
Zara Khan: Great 1 will go through the materials and join the design critique next week. Appreciate the help!
